exact_cli_after_fixes.reason: Do not launch until blocker corrections are sealed and a fresh independent pass receipt binds the corrected plan/helpers.

interpretation: Blocked before launch. The experiment scope is conceptually bounded, but the listed custody, identity, parser, timeout, and attribution-output gaps must be corrected in one fresh sealed helper/plan version before root GO.

reproduced_blockers.evidence: protocol_common_0971_v1.validate_report constructs validator cell from report.case/edits/retention; mutating a retained valid report case to docnohf was accepted.
reproduced_blockers.required_fix: Validate against fixed plan cell docfloat/e1/default_8mib and fixture/input identity before or alongside the retained validator.

reproduced_blockers.evidence: run_0971_v1.run_child uses subprocess.run timeout around taskset/perf without a process group/session kill; a timeout can leave the launcher/historical binary alive after terminal failure.
reproduced_blockers.required_fix: Run each child in a new process group/session and kill/reap the entire group on timeout, preserving stop-without-retry.

reproduced_blockers.evidence: Reducer validates packet.inline report and cached perf summary, reparses no-inline text but compares only five summary fields, trusts cached owner/unresolved/truncation maps, and does not bind/hash raw report, perf.data, decoded texts, header, launch, stderr, command, or terminal files.
reproduced_blockers.required_fix: Record and verify bytes/SHA for every raw child artifact; make full parser reparse authoritative or compare every derived field, and revalidate exact launch/report/script identity before reduction.

reproduced_blockers.evidence: parse_perf_script accepted period=0, mixed sample PIDs/CPUs, and no CPU/PID consistency check exists after launch metadata.
reproduced_blockers.required_fix: Require finite positive periods; require every sample PID to equal launch exec_pid and CPU 31 (with sample-cpu enabled), or fail closed.

reproduced_blockers.evidence: marker DSO validation compares Path(frame.dso).name only; a wrong path with the retained basename was accepted in synthetic parser replay.
reproduced_blockers.required_fix: Bind the marker DSO to the exact retained binary path/build ID, not basename alone.

reproduced_blockers.evidence: inclusive_marker_ancestor_period adds a period for each repeated resolved frame; a synthetic recursive marker counted the same period twice for one owner.
reproduced_blockers.required_fix: Deduplicate each owner per sample for inclusive coverage and document cross-owner overlap explicitly.

reproduced_blockers.evidence: reduce_0971_v1 child_rows writes p99_ns=max(elapsed), which is not the declared p99 percentile.
reproduced_blockers.required_fix: Compute the declared percentile or rename the field to max_ns and avoid p99 semantics.

reproduced_blockers.evidence: Reducer emits aggregate p50-vs-total marker-period/share correlations only; proposal requires p50 associations for each exclusive owner marker-period/share across all 12 children.
reproduced_blockers.required_fix: Retain per-child owner periods/shares and compute descriptive Pearson/Spearman per owner over all 12 children.

reproduced_blockers.evidence: plan.perf.whole_process_scope says “perf launched GNU/perf child tree”; this command has no GNU time and perf bookkeeping is outside its launched child.
reproduced_blockers.required_fix: Correct wording to perf-launched child process tree (Python launcher and execed baseline), excluding perf bookkeeping.

reproduced_blockers.evidence: check_plan_bindings omits helper/helper-seal and perf/python/taskset file hash checks; check_go does not require a passing independent-review binding or helper-file bindings.
reproduced_blockers.required_fix: Validate all helper/tool hashes at plan/GO admission and require the fresh independent review receipt/status, exact plan/protocol/helper seals, quiescence, environment, CPU31, and exclusive empty output roots.

reproduced_blockers.evidence: Relevant harness source/Cargo files independently match plan hashes, but the helper does not rehash all 924 source-manifest entries when admitting source-owner claims.
reproduced_blockers.required_fix: Bind the relevant source files/build ID in GO and retain a source-manifest content proof if full source-owner attribution is published; do not claim current-HEAD equivalence.

root_go_required_fields_after_fixes.helper_seal: path/bytes/sha256 plus every helper actual path/bytes/sha256
root_go_required_fields_after_fixes.independent_review: fresh receipt path/bytes/sha256 with status pass
root_go_required_fields_after_fixes.matrix: 12 serial children, child1 pilot, 5 warmups/80 measured, instructions:u period 5000000 dwarf,16384
root_go_required_fields_after_fixes.plan: path/bytes/sha256 exact plan-v4 (or corrected fresh plan)
root_go_required_fields_after_fixes.protocol_seal: path/bytes/sha256 exact protocol-seal-v2 or correction-bound successor
root_go_required_fields_after_fixes.scope: diagnostic only; no timing/qualification/adoption claim; warmup mix explicit
root_go_required_fields_after_fixes.source: manifest/file-manifest plus relevant harness source/Cargo hashes
root_go_required_fields_after_fixes.tools: perf/python/taskset hashes and environment LC_ALL=C LANG=C TZ=UTC

scope: Read-only independent review of sealed 0971 pre-capture plan/helpers; no Office workload, build, capture, or sealed-artifact mutation.
